brief: A workbench organizer: two storeys, bins on top, a drawer below, all edges capped.

requirements.evidence: Ground level 0 bases (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;half-n, piece:1,-1,0;full) with level 1 bases above (piece:0,0,1;full, piece:1,-1,1;full); check_build lists groups at storey 0 and storey 1.
bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full-div2 and bin:1,-1,1~hex-bin-full-div3 sit in the two top-storey cells, dressed with standing pen/marker and a screwdriver visible from the front.
drawer:0#1,0#cut fitted on the cut face of the ground-storey half base piece:1,0,0;half-n.
capOpenFaces applied (15 caps, e.g. cap:0,0,0;*;150, cap:1,-1,1;*;30) and lockJoints applied; check_build reports no issues, meshClash clear.
Divided top bins hold tools/pens for bench items; drawer below for enclosed storage; whole build passes check_build.

finish.summary: Two-storey workbench organizer: three ground bases (one half-n carrying a drawer on its cut face) supporting two full bases above, each top cell holding a divided bin (2- and 3-compartment) dressed with standing pen/marker and a screwdriver. All open faces capped with solid end caps and joints bolted via capOpenFaces + lockJoints. check_build passes with meshClash clear and no prop warnings.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

Half-n and half-s take any drawer style; half-e and half-w take a slide, swing or long drawer (find_sockets offers those once the half base is on). No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
